entities.summary: Nikoloz (Niko) Aleksandres dze Berdzenishvili was a Soviet and Georgian historian who served as a Vice President of the Georgian Academy of Sciences from 1951 to 1957 and chaired the Department of History at Tbilisi State University from 1946 to 1956.
